title: ABB Q2 2026 results
excerpt: Q2 2026 orders were USD 12.042 billion, revenues USD 9.475 billion, operational EBITA margin 20.2%, and continuing-operations operating cash flow USD 1.303 billion.
summary: ABB's current primary results support group demand, margins, cash conversion, balance-sheet strength, Robotics-disposal timing, Rotork funding, outlook, and bounded valuation inputs.
